products.name: Rosé Prosperity
products.short: Blush roses and garden spray roses in an abundant, celebratory display.
products.description: A generous, blush-toned arrangement built to stand out in a new storefront or lobby. Garden roses, spray roses and soft greenery are layered by hand for depth and movement, then finished with a satin ribbon ready for your congratulatory message.
details: Blush roses, spray roses, seasonal greenery

products.name: Peach Horizon
products.short: Peach and cream roses arranged to welcome a bright new beginning.
products.description: Warm peach, apricot and cream blooms gathered in a tall glass vessel. Elegant enough for a boutique opening, warm enough for a new office — a quiet signal of confidence and good fortune.

products.name: Grand Celebration
products.short: Our most lavish opening arrangement — roses, carnations and lush texture.
products.description: Designed to be noticed from the doorway. Pink and ivory roses, ruffled carnations and spray roses are arranged in a dense, luxurious dome — the arrangement our clients choose when the occasion deserves the very best.

products.name: Crimson Fortune
products.short: Glossy red anthurium — a classic symbol of hospitality and success.
products.description: Sculptural red anthurium with lacquered leaves, chosen for its long life and bold, architectural presence. A refined, low-maintenance gift for restaurants, salons and new business partners.

products.name: Petal Grandeur
products.short: Full, ruffled pink roses for a soft yet unforgettable welcome.
products.description: Dozens of full-petalled pink roses massed together for a romantic, high-impact display. Perfect for beauty studios, boutiques and any opening with a touch of glamour.
details: Hand-tied, presented in a keepsake box

products.name: Phalaenopsis Orchid — 20 Stem
products.short: A grand potted orchid display, twenty arching stems in full bloom.
products.description: Twenty stems of premium Phalaenopsis orchids, staked and arranged in a ceramic planter. Orchids bloom for six to ten weeks with minimal care — a lasting gesture for offices, homes and milestones.

products.name: Phalaenopsis Orchid — 18 Stem
products.short: Vivid magenta orchids, potted and ready to brighten any room.
products.description: Eighteen stems of vivid Phalaenopsis orchids in a clean, modern planter. An effortless, elegant gift that rewards a little indirect sunlight and a weekly sip of water with weeks of color.

products.name: Phalaenopsis Orchid — 6 Stem
products.short: An intimate orchid arrangement for desks, bedside tables and kitchens.
products.description: Six graceful orchid stems in a petite ceramic pot. Understated and long-lived, it suits a desk, a reception counter or a bedside table — and fits every interior.

products.name: Tulip Birthday Wishes
products.short: Fresh pink tulips — cheerful, simple and full of spring.
products.description: A cheerful gathering of pink tulips with fresh greenery, presented in a clear vase. Light, bright and joyful — exactly what a birthday morning should feel like.

products.name: Grand Birthday Bouquet
products.short: Garden roses and peonies in a lavish, hand-tied birthday statement.
products.description: Our most generous birthday bouquet: cream and pink garden roses, seasonal peonies and textured fillers, hand-tied and wrapped in our signature paper. For the birthdays that matter most.

products.name: Flathead Morning
products.short: A loose, garden-gathered bouquet inspired by summer on Flathead Lake.
products.description: Seasonal blooms chosen fresh each morning by our designers and arranged in a relaxed, just-picked style. No two are exactly alike — every one feels like a walk through a Montana garden.

products.name: Blush Peony Cloud
products.short: Lush, ruffled peonies — the most romantic flower of the season.
products.description: Generous, cloud-soft peonies in shades of blush and rose. When peonies are out of season we substitute garden roses of equal beauty and value.

products.name: Classic Dozen Red Roses
products.short: Twelve long-stem red roses — timeless, confident, unmistakable.
products.description: Twelve premium long-stem red roses with delicate greenery, hand-tied and presented in a glass vase. The universal language of love, spoken beautifully.

products.name: White Tulip Study
products.short: Crisp white tulips for the minimalist who appreciates quiet beauty.
products.description: Pure white tulips with clean, sculptural lines. Elegant on a dining table, calm on a desk, and a thoughtful gift for any occasion.

products.name: Quiet Grace
products.short: Soft white blooms arranged with dignity for remembrance and comfort.
products.description: An all-white arrangement of chrysanthemums, roses and soft greenery. Suitable for a service, a family home or a quiet moment of remembrance. Same-day delivery to funeral homes in our area.

products.name: Sunlit Field
products.short: Golden sunflowers that bring a Big Sky afternoon indoors.
products.description: Bright sunflowers with seasonal accents, gathered loosely and presented in a vase. Instantly uplifting — a favorite for get-well wishes and thank-yous.
